description: The completeness C(n) = O(n)/E(n) and gamma = E(n)/ln(n) reveal anomalous numbers defying typical Collatz statistics. The gap between C_max ~ 0.6054 and the theoretical limit ln(2)/ln(3) ~ 0.6309 is the central anomaly.
mathematical_formalization: C(n) < ln(2)/ln(3) for all n > 1 (Roosendaal Theorem 1). Conjecture 3: C_max < ln(2)/ln(3) strictly. Gap delta ~ 0.0255. If delta -> 0, delay records could grow super-exponentially.
analogical_connections: Mass gap in QCD: nonzero gap implies confinement
Spectral gap in Markov chains: determines mixing time
BCS gap in superconductivity: determines critical temperature
implementation_hypothesis: For each delay record, compute (C, gamma, delta). Plot in (C, gamma) space. Search for numbers with C > 0.605.
experiment_seed: Systematically search for numbers with high completeness in [10^17, 10^18] using binary sieve pre-filtering.
